text:
I'm sorry the replacement didn't make it. Yes, you can get one more replacement. A replacement has its own new 30-day guarantee from its delivery date, so you can claim again if it's still within that window.

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. The usual exclusions still apply, such as pests introduced after delivery or deliberate neglect.

Note that this second replacement won't carry a guarantee of its own. If you'd like help figuring out why the plants are struggling, a Plant Care Specialist can give you free care advice by chat or email.
